name: Frame Fixture
description: The E2E fixture-frame Plugin (issue #454 unit U6): one Plugin that declares customUi: true, a whole-page Frame (ui/page.html) that renders its own DOM, and a Remote UI page embedding a kit Frame (ui/embed.html). Its Worker relays a ping over the Frame's port and forwards the current UI language, so the @sandbox lane can prove the Frame's isolation, theme tokens, notice, and language forwarding on the real engines. Never shipped in a product bundle.
